sloka: एवम् उक्तः तु तेजस्वी धर्मज्ञो धर्म वत्सलः ।प्रत्युवाच स काकुत्स्थः सुग्रीवम् प्रहसन् इव ॥४-८-२०॥
transliteration: evam uktaḥ tu tejasvī dharmajño dharma vatsalaḥ ।pratyuvāca sa kākutsthaḥ sugrīvam prahasan iva ॥4-8-20॥

translations.english: Thus spoken to, the glorious Rama, lover of righteousness who knew his duty, replied to Sugriva with a smile on his face:
